recognize_zh: DAPI 藍色細胞核中，大多數只見到一個橘紅色訊號，少數細胞有兩個訊號（正常），表示 20q 探針區域單套缺失，即 del(20q)。
features: Interphase FISH with DAPI-counterstained (blue) nuclei and an orange/red locus-specific 20q probe
Most nuclei show a single orange signal, indicating loss of one 20q locus
Rare nuclei show two orange signals (normal pattern), serving as internal control
Overlapping nuclei and split signals can mimic abnormal patterns and must be excluded when scoring
describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization on bone marrow cells shows DAPI-counterstained nuclei hybridized with a 20q-specific probe. The majority of nuclei display a single orange signal, whereas occasional nuclei retain two signals. Per the report, 89% of scored nuclei showed one signal, well above the laboratory cutoff. Findings are consistent with deletion of 20q, concordant with the karyotype 46,XY,del(20)(q11.2).

ddx.vs: Overlapping or out-of-focus signals produce sporadic one-signal nuclei at low frequency below the cutoff, not in the large majority of cells.
Monosomy also gives one 20q signal, so a 20p or centromeric control probe or karyotype is needed to distinguish it from a 20q deletion.

ddx.dx: Loss of Y or other MDS FISH abnormalities
ddx.vs: These are detected with different probes and colors; the single orange signal here pertains only to the 20q locus.
